name: Request Office Equipment for Hybrid Work
goal: Employee requests additional office equipment for hybrid work (e.g., monitor, chair).
constraints: Request must be within allowed equipment limits.

testdata.justification: Need a second monitor for productivity

phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for equipment type, quantity, and justification.

phases.description: User provides valid equipment details and justification.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot checks eligibility and confirms the request.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
